definition: Batman: Beyond the White Knight is an American comic book published by DC Comics under its Black Label imprint.
details: The eight-issue limited series — written and illustrated by Sean Murphy, lettered by AndWorld Design and colored by Dave Stewart — began its monthly publication on March 29, 2022, and ended on February 14, 2023. It is the sequel to both Batman: White Knight (2017–18) and Batman: Curse of the White Knight (2019–20), and is also the fifth installment in Murphy's self-titled Murphyverse line. It is also an adaptation of the animated television series Batman Beyond (1999–2001), with the plot of the comic book being based on the original premise of the series. Batman: Beyond the White Knight takes place 12 years after the events of the previous volume Curse of the White Knight, which ended with Bruce Wayne exposed as Batman to the general public and donating his entire fortune to the people of Gotham City, and then turning himself in to the police. Since that, the city has evolved into a futuristic megalopolis known as "Neo-Gotham". Following the murder of his father Warren, young Terry McGinnis — under the orders of his employer Derek Powers — steals a technologically advanced Batsuit to become the new Batman and avenge his father's death. explainer.lead: Batman: Beyond the White Knight is an eight-issue DC Comics series that continues Sean Murphy’s White Knight story while adapting the premise of Batman Beyond. It follows Terry McGinnis becoming the new Batman in futuristic Neo-Gotham, twelve years after Bruce Wayne’s identity and fortune were given up.

tiers.eli5: Imagine a familiar superhero story jumping forward in time, with an older hero and a young person taking over his role. Terry McGinnis takes an advanced Batsuit after his father Warren is murdered, hoping to become Batman and avenge him. Meanwhile, Bruce Wayne has to deal with the world created by his earlier choices.
tiers.practitioner: This is a narrative work rather than a technical system, so there are no implementation settings or engineering tools to apply. For cataloguing or adaptation work, its key relationships are its eight-issue run, its place after two earlier White Knight series, and its use of Batman Beyond’s original premise.
tiers.paperLevel: Formally, it is an eight-issue American comic-book limited series written and illustrated by Sean Murphy, lettered by AndWorld Design, and colored by Dave Stewart. DC Comics published it monthly under Black Label from March 29, 2022 to February 14, 2023; it is the fifth Murphyverse installment and a sequel set twelve years after Curse of the White Knight.

explainer.example: Terry McGinnis’s father Warren is murdered. Acting under his employer Derek Powers’s orders, Terry steals a technologically advanced Batsuit and becomes the new Batman so he can avenge Warren’s death.

explainer.intuition: The series combines a sequel with a future-shifted Batman story: Bruce Wayne’s past actions have transformed his life and Gotham, while Terry McGinnis inherits the Batman role through a personal quest for revenge.
howItWorks: The story begins twelve years after Curse of the White Knight.
Bruce Wayne has been publicly exposed as Batman, donated his fortune to Gotham’s people, and surrendered to police.
Gotham has developed into the futuristic megalopolis Neo-Gotham.
After Warren McGinnis is murdered, Derek Powers orders Terry McGinnis to steal an advanced Batsuit.
Terry uses the suit to become Batman and seek vengeance, while the middle-aged Bruce escapes.
explainer.whyItMatters: It links Murphy’s White Knight continuity to Batman Beyond, showing how Bruce Wayne’s exposed identity and surrendered fortune lead into a future where a new Batman emerges.
misconceptions: It is not a standalone story: it follows both Batman: White Knight and Batman: Curse of the White Knight.
Terry McGinnis is the new Batman; Bruce Wayne is the older figure whose earlier decisions shape the setting.
It is a comic-book limited series, not an animated television series.
